Workload_Hub_Description:
Azure IoT Solution Accelerator for Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence enables customers to accelerate operational analytics, monitoring, alerting, and AI-driven insights using data from Azure IoT solutions.

**With this accelerator you can:**

• Configure ingestion of IoT Hub telemetry and device twin changes into a Fabric Eventhouse.
• Build Real-Time Dashboards over live device telemetry and properties.
• Set up alerts with Activator and explore your data using a Data Agent.
• Optionally enrich raw device data with semantic context from DTDL device models and generate query-ready modeled tables.

**Designed for:**

• Azure IoT Hub customers.
• Azure IoT Hub and Device Provisioning Service (DPS) customers.
• Customers building new IoT analytics solutions on Microsoft Fabric.
• Partners creating industry-specific solutions with Azure IoT and Fabric.
